reason: The README clearly describes a DSH WebUI plugin whose primary purpose is transforming vague user requests into structured, executable prompts for AI agents using the currently selected model.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DSH WebUI 插件，可将输入框中的模糊需求改写为结构化、可执行且便于验收的 AI 智能体提示词。
summaries.en: A DSH WebUI plugin that rewrites vague input requests into structured, executable, and verifiable prompts for AI agents.

capabilities: Sends the prompt to the currently selected model for optimization
Replaces the input field with the optimized prompt
Locks the input and send controls during optimization
Caches optimization results and deduplicates concurrent requests
